remarks: Welcome to your dream home in the heart of Westport, CT! This stunning 5-bedroom, 5 full and 2 half-bath residence offers the perfect blend of luxury, space, and convenience. Nestled on a meticulously landscaped 1.03-acre lot, this recently renovated gem features a 3-car garage, a full walk-out basement, and a private sport court for endless outdoor fun.  The interior of the home boasts a contemporary design with high-end finishes throughout. The spacious and bright open-concept living areas are perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with state-of-the-art appliances, custom cabinetry, and an expansive island.  Each of the five bedrooms is generously sized, providing comfort and privacy. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a luxurious en-suite bath, ample closet space and private sun deck. The walk-out basement offers additional living space, ideal for a home gym, media room, or guest suite.  Located in a centrally positioned, walkable neighborhood, you'll enjoy easy access to Westport's renowned schools, beautiful beaches, and vibrant downtown area. Experience the best of both worlds with tranquil suburban living just minutes away from all the amenities you need.  This exceptional home is a rare find in one of Westport's most sought-after communities. Don't miss the opportunity to make it yours!
